- Many examples come from fitness/exercise content: workout instructions ("jump as high and as far to the left as possible"), exercise holds ("Hold for up to 45 seconds"), rowing technique, functional fitness training

- Weight management: "gaining weight", "fat loss", "Weight gain supplements", "burning more fat"
- Health and physical performance: "bone mass loss", "strength, balance and flexibility", "memory capacity"
- Sports and athletic competition: wrestling, rowing championships, power rankings

Even the seemingly unrelated examples often touch on the body (depilatories/hair removal, impotence, burlesque, diet/nutrition lists).
